metric_formula_definitions.monthly_ic: Monthly mean of daily rank IC from period_ic_summary
metric_formula_definitions.monthly_ic_positive_rate: Fraction of months with positive direction-adjusted IC
metric_formula_definitions.long_short_sharpe: mean(monthly_LS) / std(monthly_LS) * sqrt(12) — monthly annualization (not per-bar)
metric_formula_definitions.cumulative_ls: cumulative product of (1 + monthly_LS) - 1 — requires monthly LS

disclaimer: Factor diagnostics metrics. Diagnostic only. Not production. Not live trading.

pm58b_ls_annualization.sharpe_vol_formula: monthly LS mean/std × √12 (monthly edge stability metrics, not portfolio)
pm58b_ls_annualization.note: LS Sharpe/Ann Vol are monthly edge stability metrics. Ann Return is annualized per-bar LS edge. These are research diagnostics, not portfolio metrics or trading signals.

edge_diagnostics.description: Monthly per-bar LS edge stability metrics

window_diagnostics.description: Period-level window diagnostics from monthly period LS summary. Each monthly period = one window. NOT true per-bar investment-window data.
window_diagnostics.nonoverlap_note: Monthly subsampling approximation. True non-overlap requires per-bar data.
window_diagnostics.period_level_note: Current implementation uses monthly period LS returns. True per-bar / non-overlapping investment-window diagnostics require raw per-bar LS return output and are deferred.

pm58c_ls_metric_semantics.disclaimer: Neither edge nor window diagnostics are portfolio metrics or trading signals.
